headline: DR Congo hunts missing plane as rebels claim shootdown
pages: The Democratic Republic of Congo's military says it is searching for one of its aircraft after rebels claimed to have shot down a warplane in the east. The army said it lost contact with a small Cessna 208 cargo plane on Sunday amid poor weather, and the fate of the crew is unknown. The same day, the rebel Front for the Refoundation of the Nation said it downed a plane of the same type that was on a bombing mission to Minembwe in South Kivu province. The group says a Ugandan and a South African pilot were captured, and that the wreckage lies 10 km from Minembwe. The BBC could not verify the claim or confirm that the two planes are the same.
Uganda's military denied involvement, and South Africa has not commented. Source: BBC News.
